subject: Re: Kickoff: Differentiable Data Selection for vision training
body:
Lucia,

Sizing and money.

Staffing: Quentin 50% on reproduction and the scorer training, Bilal 40% on porting our internal corpus into the input pipeline, Amara 30% on infra and the Cirrus scheduling glue.

Compute: reproduction fits in the vision portfolio's Cirrus quarterly allocation -- the reference runs use batch 1024 at 32x32, which is modest. The internal-corpus pilot is the expensive part: images are 4x larger and the DDS recipe means training essentially twice (scorer model, then the DDS run). My estimate is it exceeds our remaining quarterly allocation by roughly 40%.

On covering that gap: Idris Osei has verbally earmarked $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-13 for this project. I want to convert that to a written commitment before we schedule the pilot burns -- verbal is verbal.

Bao
